articles.title: Never written a line of code. Just got my game approved on Steam.
articles.summary: I've been "going to make this game" for years. Couldn't code. Didn't know what bash was. Couldn't open my own terminal. Talk is cheap. Until 30 days ago, making games wasn't. > Enter my new BFF Claude 60k lines I didn't write but can read. 5 factions, 62 races, 87 abilities, real multiplayer over Steam. Builds on Mac, Windows, Linux, Steam Deck. Early Access June 1. I'm not a developer. I'm a guy who finally stopped finding reasons not to start. Sad. True. **Don't care.** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4684510/ARB\_Alien\_Races\_Battle/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4684510/ARB_Alien_Races_Battle/) P.S --- If anyone would like to test I'm ready. Keys are unlocked 5/19.
